data.name: Edsel
data.gender_notes: Edsel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Edsel is derived from Old English words ed, meaning 'wealth,' and sel, meaning 'pledge' or 'prosperous.' It was a popular name in England during the Middle Ages and was brought to America by early settlers. The name carries a strong sense of wealth, prosperity, and security. The name Edsel carries the meaning “Wealthy pledge, prosperous” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Edsel usually hope their child will grow to embody wealthy pledge, prosperous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
